body: May isang extra leading signal sa operating layer: SourcePod's own press list now shows an Aug. 31 paid-license rollout for its SCS support platform, plus an earlier July customer implementation. That adds evidence na vendors and some early users are preparing before the formal ★3/★4 launch. Pero hindi ko tataasan ang 81 score dahil dito lang—ecosystem readiness ito, hindi pa proof na major buyers are putting SCS into procurement contracts. Signal, yes. Victory lap, hindi pa.

claims.text: SourcePod's press-release list shows an August 31 announcement for a paid SCS support-platform license rollout in early September and a July 1 announcement describing an SCS-related customer implementation.
These announcements strengthen the signal that a commercial support ecosystem is forming ahead of formal SCS launch, but do not establish broad buyer-side procurement adoption.
claims.basis: Supply-side readiness is distinct from buyer-side demand
